messages:
pagerduty: :rotating_light: INC0012345 — Verdigris VPC auth failures. Multiple token introspection errors observed for verdigris-pool-1. Severity: Sev2. Paging maya (oncall). Details: https://pagerduty/INC0012345

maya (oncall): on it. seeing spike in 401 from auth-proxy in the private control plane. starting triage.

maya (oncall): quick check — is this limited to verdigris or wider? infra-metrics show error-rate concentrated on pool=verdigris-pool-1.

ana (Verdigris SRE): @maya yep, we started seeing failed API calls at ~14:03 UTC. Token introspection against our IdP is returning 500 for some tokens. We haven't rotated anything recently.

maya (oncall): copying logs. pulling last 100 auth-proxy logs now.

maya (oncall): logs snippet:
```
2026-06-14T14:03:12Z auth-proxy[verdigris-pool-1] ERROR introspect.go:87 "introspect failed" err="x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid"
2026-06-14T14:03:13Z auth-proxy[verdigris-pool-1] WARN upstream_call.go:45 401 introspect response for token=redacted
```

sam: reading that as TLS trust issue to the IdP jwks/oidc endpoint. can you curl the jwks endpoint from one of the control-plane hosts?

maya (oncall): running from cp-03 now:
```
curl -v https://verdigris-idp.company.internal/.well-known/jwks.json 2>&1 | sed -n '1,80p'
* Connected to verdigris-idp.company.internal (10.0.55.12) port 443 (#0)
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)
* TLSv1.3 (OUT), TLS handshake, Encrypted Extensions (8)
* SSL certificate problem: certificate has expired
```

sam: confirms. the IdP cert is expired (x509). likely outbound connection failing during TLS.

elliot: do we have any fallback for JWKS cache expiration? iirc runtime has a 24h cache, but if introspection requires TLS handshake to IdP and certificate invalid, we'll get 401s.

maya (oncall): runtime logs show repeated JWKS fetches hitting error. caching didn't help because of introspect path flow that revalidates.

ana (Verdigris SRE): we control that IdP. i'm starting an emergency cert rotation from our side. ETA ~20 min to issuance and upload. Will update.

maya (oncall): thanks. short-term mitigations: 1) enable local JWKS static cache on the control plane for verdigris-pool-1 to avoid outbound TLS until cert rotated. 2) if needed, temporarily route verdigris traffic to a backup auth path (fallback provider).

sam: i'll take the static-cache action. runbook: incidents/oidc-fallback -> step 2 (apply static jwks).

sam: applying static JWKS to verdigris-pool-1 config now:
```bash
./infractl set jwks-cache --pool verdigris-pool-1 --file /opt/ops/verdigris/jwks-static.json --ttl 86400
```

deploy-bot: started deploy job deploy/infra/jwks-cache-verdigris-1767000000 (patch)

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded on 3 targets (cp-01, cp-02, cp-03) in 45s.

maya (oncall): rolling checks. auth-proxy 401s down from 120/min -> 5/min in last 2m. looks promising.

ana (Verdigris SRE): cert rotation in progress on our IdP, will share new cert thumbprint in ~15m. if you still need the static-cache, keep it for now.

elliot: monitor token failures and user-impact metrics. Sam can you set an alert for residual 5xx/4xx > 10/min?

sam: alert rule created: infra.alerts:verdigris-auth-residual-threshold -> severity: warning -> trigger if auth_failures > 10 in 1m.

maya (oncall): customer impact note for status page: Verdigris customers on private VPC may experience auth failures causing 401s for API calls between 14:03-14:40 UTC. partial mitigation applied with local JWKS cache at 14:10 UTC.

ana (Verdigris SRE): uploaded new cert to IdP and pushed to edge at 14:28 UTC. confirming TLS handshake now.

maya (oncall): re-curl from cp-03:
```
* Connected to verdigris-idp.company.internal (10.0.55.12) port 443 (#0)
* TLSv1.3 handshake complete
* HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{ "keys": [ ... ] }
```

maya (oncall): full flow validated: introspection returning 200 and auth-proxy 401s dropped to baseline.

sam: removing static JWKS cache to return to normal config:
```bash
./infractl unset jwks-cache --pool verdigris-pool-1
```

deploy-bot: started deploy job deploy/infra/jwks-cache-verdigris-rollback-1767000000

deploy-bot: rollback deploy succeeded on 3 targets.

maya (oncall): handing off to Sam for post-incident cleanup and RCA. taking notes for postmortem.

maya (oncall): handoff: 14:40 UTC -> Sam taking over.

sam: taking it. will open a ticket, schedule RCA with Verdigris for 15:30 UTC, and draft a short postmortem. action items:
- confirm IdP cert rotation process with Verdigris (owner: Ana)
- add a health check to catch IdP cert expiry earlier (owner: infra)
- improve JWKS cache fallback behavior in runtime (owner: eng-runtime)

ana (Verdigris SRE): thanks all. we'll add monitoring for cert expiry and automate rotation.

elliot: nice quick mitigation. recommend we add runbook note to avoid enabling static jwks on more pools than necessary. also
automate a stale-cert alert in onboarding checklist for private customers.

sam: created ticket INF-7893 (RCA + followups) and status update ticket STATUS-558. assigning followups to relevant teams.

maya (oncall): closing incident thread here, will attach logs and timeline to INF-7893. great work. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: INCIDENT RESOLVED — INC0012345 resolved at 14:41 UTC.
